feature: Gradle Settings plugin `org.autojs.build.platform-versions`, which decides the AGP and Kotlin Gradle plugin versions automatically
Build host detection, covering Android Studio/IntelliJ IDEA/Temurin JDK and the bare command line
AGP version decision, matching the current IDE version against the mapping table and rounding down to the nearest entry
Stale mapping table fallback, switching to auto selection when the current IDE is newer than every entry in the table, instead of silently downgrading to an outdated AGP
AGP version capped against the Gradle compatibility table, so the chosen version is always loadable by the current Gradle
Kotlin Gradle plugin version decision, following the newest version the current Gradle supports
Compatibility data shipped with the plugin, with a `gradle/data` directory in the consumer project able to override any data file of the same name
`OVERRIDDEN_*` escape hatch in `version.properties`, for pinning versions directly and skipping the automatic decision
Decision results exposed through `PlatformVersionsExtension`, ready for buildscript classpath declarations
Minimal consumer project `sample`, for verifying the decision results in three typical scenarios
Multilingual resources for README and CHANGELOG: Spanish/French/Russian/Arabic/Japanese/Korean/English/Simplified Chinese/Traditional Chinese (Hong Kong)/Traditional Chinese (Taiwan)
